-- forever-route-lab RXP parser fixture 02: filter expressions, conditional header lines and step tags.
-- Self-authored (GPL-3.0-or-later). Quest IDs reuse fixture 01 (QuestieDB data/Forever @ b6f5b07).
-- Coordinates are placeholders, except the Gornek and Zureetha NPC positions reused from fixture 01.
-- The point of this file is syntax, not a playable route.
-- Expected filter results are written for profile P1 = {faction Horde, race Orc, class WARRIOR,
-- gender Male, level 3, locale enUS, game FOREVER}. See docs/RXP.md section 6 for the rules.
#forever
#version 2
#name 4-6 Fixture Two
-- First applicable line wins for a repeated header key, so these two lines must stay in this order.
#displayname 4-6 Fixture Two (Alliance) << Alliance
#displayname 4-6 Fixture Two (Horde) << Horde
#group Forever Route Lab Fixtures
#subgroup Parser Samples
#next Forever Route Lab Fixtures\6-8 Fixture Three;6-8 Fixture Three (Alt)
#defaultfor Orc Warrior/Troll Warrior
-- Step filter: whole step dropped for P1 (Orc).

step << !Orc !Troll
    #completewith next
    +|cRXP_WARN_This guide was written for Orcs and Trolls|r
    -- Step filter with a parenthesised group: (Orc/Troll) AND Warrior -> shown for P1.
step << (Orc/Troll) Warrior
    #sticky
    #label WarriorSticky
    >> Keep an eye out for |cRXP_ENEMY_Scorpid Workers|r while questing
    .complete 789,1
    .mob Scorpid Worker
step
    #xprate <1.5
    #season 0
    #softcore
    .goto Durotar,44.00,60.00,30
    >> This step only exists at XP rate below 1.5, season 0, hardcore off
step
    #xprate >1.49
    #hardcore
    .goto Durotar,44.50,60.50,30
    >> This step only exists at XP rate above 1.49 with hardcore on
step
    #requires WarriorSticky
    #completewith WarriorSticky
    .goto Durotar,45.00,61.00
    >> Only shown once the WarriorSticky step has completed (requires) and ends with it
step
    #optional
    #label Boars
step
    #hidewindow
    #loop
    #completewith Boars2
    .goto Durotar,45.00,70.00,0
    .goto Durotar,45.00,70.00,35,0
    .goto Durotar,46.00,68.00,35,0
    .goto Durotar,44.00,69.00,35,0
    +1
step
    #label Boars2
    #level 3
    .goto Durotar,45.50,69.00,-1
    .goto Durotar,44.50,71.00,-1
    >> Kill boars near either point (closest-point arrow)
    .complete 788,1
    .mob Mottled Boar
    -- Line-level filters. Expected for P1 in the trailing comment of each line.
step
    >> Common line, no filter --shown
    >> Warrior or Rogue only << Warrior/Rogue --shown
    >> Orc Warrior or Troll Rogue << Orc Warrior/Troll Rogue --shown
    >> Not an Orc << !Orc --hidden
    >> Neither Mage nor Priest << !Mage !Priest --shown
    >> Not (Orc or Troll) << !(Orc/Troll) --hidden
    >> Level 3 or higher at first evaluation << 3 --shown
    >> Below level 5 at first evaluation << !5 --shown
    >> Female characters << Female --hidden
    >> German clients only << deDE --hidden
    >> Forever game token << Forever --shown
    >> Classic game token is false on Forever even though the #classic header is accepted << Classic --hidden
    >> Two filters on one line are ANDed, not ORed << tbc wotlk --hidden
    >> Undead is an alias for the Scourge race token << Undead --hidden
    >> Night Elf splits into two ANDed tokens and never matches << Night Elf --hidden
    >> Unknown words evaluate false << skip --hidden
    .goto Durotar,42.06,68.33 << Warrior --shown
    .turnin 788 >> Turn in Cutting Teeth << Horde --shown
    .accept 789 >> Pick up Sting of the Scorpid
    .target Gornek
    -- The idiom "step << skip" disables a whole step for every character.
step << skip
    .goto Durotar,40.00,65.00
    .accept 790 >> Never reached
    -- A step tag whose value carries its own filter (first applicable wins).
step
    #completewith next << Warrior/Rogue
    #completewith Boars << !Warrior !Rogue
    >> Tag values can be filtered too
    .complete 792,1
step
    .goto 1411,42.85,69.15
    .turnin 792 >> Hand in Vile Familiars
